# bexio-cli

> Command-line client for the bexio business software: contacts, quotes,
> sales orders, invoices (with payments and reminders), items & stock,
> deliveries, projects & timesheets, notes & tasks, and master data.
> Single static Go binary, configured via ~/.config/bexio/config.yml or the
> BEXIO_TOKEN environment variable; supports several bexio companies as
> named instances.

The CLI is self-documenting for LLMs: run `bexio docs` for a compact
reference (conventions, search syntax, command index), then
`bexio docs <command>` for one resource's details on demand
(`--full` prints everything). Every read command supports `-o json`,
printing the raw bexio API objects.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/bexio-cli/blob/main/README.md): install, auth, usage
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/bexio-cli/blob/main/skills/bexio/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for AI agents operating the CLI
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/bexio-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): commit convention, release automation
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/bexio-cli/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): architecture and bexio API facts for coding agents

## Optional

- [bexio API docs](https://docs.bexio.com): upstream REST API reference
